author: Torva, a traveller
pages:
Third day under the canvas. The snow will not stop and Hjalmund has gone ahead to find the road. He said he would be back by dark. I have kept the fire low to save the wood.

I counted the dried meat twice. If I am careful, five more days.

Fifth day. No Hjalmund. Wolves in the night, close enough that I heard them breathing. I have decided to go after him at first light and leave this book here, in case he comes back another way.

Hjalmund, if you read this: I went down the slope, towards the river. Wait for me.
